en: A black-and-white photograph shows a symmetrical street scene in a small European town, with a circular fenced-in monument at the center of a wide dirt intersection. The monument appears to be a bust on a pedestal with decorative scripted text, set inside a manicured garden with cone-shaped and rounded trimmed bushes. The street is lined with trees and ornate 19th-century buildings. In the distance, a church with a tall spire dominates the skyline, and a blurred horse-drawn carriage moves along the road. At the top of the image, some handwritten or printed text is visible but difficult to fully decipher.
